optimizedDescription.value: Detect graph stale via VCS ref + derivation fingerprint; warn-not-block reads; GetGraphHealth canonical; index repairs mismatch.

optimizedContext.value:
# Staleness Detection
## Rules
### VCS ref storage at index time
- Optional `IndexOptions.vcsRef: string` → persist as `lastIndexedRef` after successful index
- Opaque string (`VcsAdapter.ref()`); omit → `lastIndexedRef` stays `null` (unknown OK)

### Staleness comparison
- **stale**: `lastIndexedRef != null` AND current `VcsAdapter.ref()` differs
- **fresh**: `lastIndexedRef != null` AND refs equal
- **unknown**: `lastIndexedRef === null` — MUST NOT treat as stale

### Graph derivation freshness
- Distinct from VCS freshness
- **derivation mismatch**: persisted fingerprint ≠ current run fingerprint
- Fingerprint from: effective `@specd/code-graph` version + canonical hash of resolved workspaces from `specd.yaml`
- Surface explicitly in diagnostics even if VCS-fresh

### Warn-not-block policy
- Read cmds (`graph stats|search|impact|hotspots`): warn if stale, still return results

### Derivation mismatch policy
- Reads surface mismatch metadata; MUST NOT treat mismatched as fresh
- Repair via `graph index`: full rebuild w/ visible reason OR fail requiring force re-index
- Independent of VCS freshness

### GraphStatistics extension
- Add `lastIndexedRef: string | null` beside `lastIndexedAt`

### Staleness in graph stats output
- Text: after Last indexed → `⚠ Graph is stale (indexed at <7-char>, current: <7-char>)`; null ref → no line; mismatch → `⚠ Derivation fingerprint mismatch — graph built with different code-graph version or workspace configuration`
- JSON/TOON: `stale: boolean|null`, `currentRef: string|null`, `fingerprintMismatch: boolean|null`

### Centralized index lock control
- FS lock in config dir (e.g. `.specd/config/graph/index.lock`)
- Acquire/release/assert (`assertGraphIndexUnlocked`) for concurrent-index prevention

### Health orchestration use case
- Primitives `isGraphStale` + fingerprint helpers stay here
- Hosts MUST NOT reimplement assembly when `GetGraphHealth` available — canonical for stats/status/SDK

### Effective configuration building
- Merge workspace `allowedPaths`/`excludePaths`/`respectGitignore` + global + CLI overrides → effective `ProjectGraphConfig`

### Bootstrap fallback configuration
- No `specd.yaml` → synthetic `SpecdConfig` with single `default` workspace at repo root for graph cmds

## Constraints
- VCS-agnostic via `@specd/core` `VcsAdapter`
- Opaque ref string; no auto-refresh on detect
- Lock/bootstrap/merge/staleness encapsulated in `@specd/code-graph` (or core), not CLI helpers
